scenarios.title: Synthetic GitHub OAuth and PKCE lifecycle
plannedActions: GET OAuth start valid challenge and client state
POST exchange correct verifier after failures
expectedOutcomes: Correct proof authenticates only after incorrect proof fails without consumption; exact persisted synthetic identity contains only the verified primary email.

State and exchange replay fail. Across cancellation and three simulated provider failure cases plus their replays, every persisted users, sessions and auth_codes row equals the immutable pre-cancellation baseline. Auxiliary DB reads are separate from 24 public HTTP actions.

associations.rationale: Exact-length unsupported PKCE challenge is rejected. Local simulated-provider HTTP only, not real login or measured execution.
associations.uncertainty: Synthetic local provider only; no live GitHub, native, expiry or concurrent callbacks tested. Persistence equality observes final rows, not transient insert/delete within one completed request.
proposedAssertions: GET OAuth start malformed challenge has independently asserted status and public result.
